affected_component: Workspace reference repair and Core-owned offline runtime closure
invariant: A task-owned workspace reference may create only application and domain artifacts. When an offline Python runtime closure is required, the trusted Core exclusively supplies the launcher, dependency lock, third-party inventory and vendored wheel tree. Bounded reference repair must reject an ownership violation before saving it, disclose only the public policy reason to a final repair attempt, and classify a runtime-owned collision as a pre-freeze contract-control failure rather than an Agent failure.
